references.text: Describes how the nations and their kings gather against the Lord's anointed, which can be seen as a parallel to how the religious leaders gathered against Jesus.
Daniel predicts that the Messiah will be put to death, which corresponds with the plans to kill Jesus.
Tells how the religious leaders planned to arrest and kill Jesus, which is directly related to the events in Matthew 27:1.
The chief priests and the whole council seek false testimony against Jesus so that they can condemn him to death, which is a continuation of the plans mentioned in Matthew 27:1.
